01. For Campus Supervision Assistant positions, which sites are you open to working at? Options: Camarillo Heights STEM Academy | Dos Caminos School | Las Mariposa School | Las Colinas Middle School | Las Posas School | Los Primeros School of Science and Arts | Monte Vista Middle School | Pleasant Valley School of Engineering and Arts | Rancho Rosal School | Tierra Linda School | Santa Rosa Technology Magnet School
Maintain District standards of excellent customer service and professional behavior in various and sometimes challenging situations.
Access and monitor District email daily to receive important updates from school and District administration.
Participate in staff development and in-service training programs as assigned.
Model positive behavior and communication, promoting courtesy in all interactions.
Observe and adapt to changes at the discretion of a supervisor.

Monitor and supervise students in the hallways, eating areas, rest rooms, parking lots, bus loading zones and playground areas on campus; redirects inappropriate playground behavior and helps students resolve conflicts. Directs movement of individual or groups of students to and from the playground/lunch area and other various areas on campus.
Conduct perimeter checks and monitoring of assigned quadrants and identify potential safety risks.
Address minor disputes while encouraging appropriate conflict resolution techniques.
Observe and anticipate student behavior to prevent potential conflicts.
Alerts administration of any major incidents or concerns and completes or assists with incident reports as necessary.
Circulate throughout designated campus areas during mealtime to help students observe and develop proper dining habits and resolve problems as needed.
Seat and dismiss students from the lunch areas.
Wipe tables and benches in all lunch areas.
Maintain a harmonious and pleasant atmosphere in the lunch areas.
Assist as needed with campus beautification projects (i.e., light cleaning/wiping down of high touch surface areas, assisting with picking up trash, etc.)
Issue approved equipment for use in lunchtime activities; maintain order in games and play activities.
Open and close facilities for outdoor user groups. Escort and direct authorized visitors to destination; provide general information and assistance.
Direct visitors to the office and ensure only authorized personnel are on school grounds. Immediately notify the site administrator of any suspicious person, activity or unsafe conditions on campus.
Escort students as needed to and from designated locations on campus.
Maintain traffic control in parking areas as assigned.
Work with individual students to enhance positive behavior.
Assist in fostering an environment that stimulates growth of desirable social, emotional and health habits.
Provide supervision and/or direction at various school functions including, but not limited to, open house, school dances, etc.
Assist office staff with light clerical duties such as filing, assembling packets, making copies, device distribution and intake, light record keeping, etc.
Participate in staff development and in-service training programs as assigned.
